name: Surfer SEO
tagline: SEO content optimization and AI writing based on SERP analysis

pricing.notes: Official pricing checked; 2026 public sources list Standard/Essential around $99/month monthly, while Discovery annual-effective starts lower.

verdictSummary: A SERP-scrape-to-content-brief tool is buildable, but reliable SERP data, NLP scoring, editor workflow, AI articles, audits, and integrations create ongoing work.
coreLoopDIY: Fetch top SERP pages via API, extract headings/entities/terms, score a draft, and produce brief/editor suggestions.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because content optimization needs repeatable data and an editor that writers will use.

priorArt.name: OpenSearch + custom scripts
priorArt.desc: No single maintained open-source Surfer clone found; DIY usually combines SERP APIs, NLP l

notes: Great kinda: not impossible, but the core data and scoring need upkeep.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Surfer SEO (SEO content optimization and AI writing based on SERP analysis). Requirements:

- Core loop: Fetch top SERP pages via API, extract headings/entities/terms, score a draft, and produce brief/editor suggestions.
- Needs: search/SERP API.
- Needs: web scraper/parser.
- Needs: LLM API.
- Needs: content editor.
- Needs: scoring logic.
- Needs: hosted backend.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: SERP data reliability; scoring model; editor UX.
